description: Deep architecture refactor of the LCA cognitive-agent codebase (Round 2): remove residual ContextFiles forwarding shims and unify the MemoryTools directory seam, consolidate the Transport Read Runs micro-packages into deep modules, then run full regression verification and close the tracker. Tasks 1-2 (DecisionGates flattening, Ingest consolidation) are already done on this branch.

userStories.title: Remove residual ContextFiles shims and unify MemoryTools directory seam
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the stale ContextFiles forwarding shims physically deleted and the assistant memory tools to share a single file-store/directory seam, so the memory subsystem has one import path and no per-call ad-hoc construction.
acceptanceCriteria: Update lca/infrastructure/memory/contextfiles/service/watch.py to import directly from contextfiles/sync.py (no imports from contextfiles.domain.diff, contextfiles.domain.edit, or contextfiles.service.memory_edit_sync)

In lca/infrastructure/tools/assistant/memory_tools.py, add read-only properties _file_store, _sidechat_dir, _people_dir, _groups_dir to _BaseMemoryTool providing the correct DiskFileStore / SideChatDirectory / PeopleDirectory / GroupsDirectory instances
All derived memory tools use the _BaseMemoryTool properties instead of constructing their own DiskFileStore and directory instances per call
Physically delete lca/infrastructure/memory/contextfiles/domain/diff.py, lca/infrastructure/memory/contextfiles/domain/edit.py, and lca/infrastructure/memory/contextfiles/service/memory_edit_sync.py
A repo-wide grep finds zero non-doc imports of contextfiles.domain.diff, contextfiles.domain.edit, or contextfiles.service.memory_edit_sync
Add tests/infrastructure/memory/test_contextfiles_shims_removed.py asserting the three shim files are gone and no old-path import remains

Add tests/infrastructure/tools/test_memory_tools_unified_context_seam.py asserting the _BaseMemoryTool seam provides correct working-directory context to derived tools and leaks no state across sessions
uv run pytest tests/infrastructure/memory/test_contextfiles_shims_removed.py tests/infrastructure/tools/test_memory_tools_unified_context_seam.py --no-cov -v passes
uv run pytest tests/infrastructure/memory/ tests/infrastructure/tools/ --no-cov -v passes
uv run ruff check passes on all touched files
Do NOT change AssistantMemory semantics and do NOT touch lca/cognition/memory/
userStories.notes: Plan source: docs/plans/2026-10-05-codebase-architecture-round2-plan.md Task 3. Invariants INV-ARCH-12 and INV-ARCH-13.

userStories.title: Consolidate Transport Read Runs micro-packages into deep modules
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the read-side run projections currently scattered across 9 micro-directories consolidated into 4 deep flat modules, so run queries are easy to find and maintain.
acceptanceCriteria: Create lca/plugins/transport/webserver/read/runs/terminal.py covering terminal-state materialization and terminal lifecycle queries
Create lca/plugins/transport/webserver/read/runs/live.py covering active run streams, step-tree refresh, and journal projection binding
Create lca/plugins/transport/webserver/read/runs/evidence.py covering evidence extraction, failure diagnostics, and formatted presentation
Create lca/plugins/transport/webserver/read/runs/identity.py covering session identity retrieval and metadata
Update lca/plugins/transport/webserver/read/runs/__init__.py to re-export the common read operations
Update lca/plugins/transport/webserver/handlers/runs/api/query_endpoints.py and lca/plugins/transport/webserver/handlers/runs/session/builder/builder.py to import from the flat modules

Delete micro-directories: read/runs/artifact/, read/runs/error/, read/runs/evidence/, read/runs/failure/, read/runs/identity/, read/runs/journal/, read/runs/live/, read/runs/step/, read/runs/terminal/
A repo-wide grep finds zero non-doc imports referencing the deleted read/runs micro-directory paths

Add tests/lca_plugins/transport/webserver/test_read_runs_unified.py covering terminal-state materialization, live tree refresh, evidence formatting, and asserting the micro-directories no longer exist
uv run pytest tests/lca_plugins/transport/webserver/test_read_runs_unified.py --no-cov -v passes
uv run pytest tests/lca_plugins/transport/webserver/ --no-cov -v passes
Do NOT change HTTP route contracts or response JSON formats in query_endpoints.py
